Saltus et al.: Antarctic Gravity Data

1

Abstract

This report describes data for 64 gravity measurements made during three field seasons in Antarctica. In 1985-1986, 19 measurements were made in McMurdo and in the vicinity of the Beardmore field camp. In 1986-1987, 34 measurements were made in McMurdo and in the vicinity of the Dry Valleys. In 1991- 1992,

11 measurements were made in McMurdo and in the vicinity of the CASERTZ field camp. The measurements were made by U.S. Geological Survey personnel with Lacoste and Romberg gravity meters G-17, G191,
